name: Phyrexia
description: The force that spread through and compleated Mirrodin, overwhelming the Mirrans.

description_citations.text: "New Phyrexia". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorine says Dagsson ignored Phyrexia's lessons in building a mechanical utopia.
timeline.quote: "Dagsson should have paid attention to the lessons of Phyrexia before attempting to create a mechanical utopia."

citation.text: Phyrexian Boon (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kaervek sells secrets of Phyrexia at a steep price.
timeline.quote: "The secrets of Phyrexia are expensive. You will pay in brass and bone, steel and sinew."

citation.text: Phyrexian Vault (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gix rises to the rank of praetor in the Phyrexian regime.
timeline.quote: Gix rose through the Phyrexian regime to the exalted rank of praetor.

citation.text: Gix (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Xantcha is sentenced to death by Phyrexia but rescued by Urza.
timeline.quote: she was rescued by Urza and joined his crusade.

citation.text: Xantcha (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza attacks Phyrexia and Phyrexia slowly retaliates.
timeline.quote: Urza dared to attack Phyrexia. Slowly, it retaliated.

citation.text: Sicken (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nine planeswalkers seek the annihilation of Phyrexia to save Dominaria.
timeline.quote: To save Dominaria, nine planeswalkers sought the annihilation of Phyrexia itself.

citation.text: Implode (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza sees a vision of Mishra deep in Yawgmoth's realm.
timeline.quote: Deep in Yawgmoth's realm, Urza stopped dead in his tracks and rubbed his soot-filled eyes. "Mishra?"

citation.text: Urza's Guilt (Planeshift, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Freyalise clears a path through Phyrexia, buying the planeswalkers time.
timeline.quote: Freyalise bought the planeswalkers the time they needed by clearing a path through the misshapen hell of Phyrexia.

citation.text: Tranquil Path (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Freyalise sets a bomb against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: now you will pay for your treachery.

citation.text: Pernicious Deed (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard rejects Yawgmoth's false Hanna.
timeline.quote: You're not my Hanna!

citation.text: Jilt (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kruphix reveals his fear: threats from the Eldrazi, an ancient dragon planeswalker and Phyrexia could destroy Theros while even the gods are powerless.
timeline.quote: even the gods may be powerless to stop them.

citation.text: "Kruphix's Insight" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jun 2014.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls that Elspeth left Dominaria for Mirrodin, which other planeswalkers now say is dead with Phyrexia returned.
timeline.quote: Then other Planeswalkers had spread the word: Mirrodin is dead. Phyrexia has returned.

citation.text: "Ajani, Mentor of Heroes" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Dec 2014.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
timeline.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Break-In" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: In the Phyrexian laboratory Tamiyo awakens Phyrexianized, loyal to Phyrexia and calling it her new family.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia was her new home.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
timeline.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

citation.text: "Episode 5: Threads of War" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jan 2022.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
timeline.quote: We welcome you to our great work.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Karn speaks of Jhoira and is cut off by Elesh Norn; Tezzeret sees it as a good move on his part.
timeline.quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn dismisses Tezzeret, who leaves angrily.
timeline.quote: With a growl, Tezzeret turned and walked away.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kaito, hit by a wall of electrostatic wind on entering New Phyrexia, lies hypnotized on the metal beach, sure it is paradise.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia wasn't a peril, it was a paradise, and he should just relax and let it wash over him

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer shakes Kaito and strikes him in the face, breaking the hypnotic spell so that he hears the battle around him.
timeline.quote: he realized that what he'd taken for the sound of waves was actually the sound of metal clashing on metal

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds his sword and tanuki drone gone, and the Wanderer begins flickering out of the plane.
timeline.quote: He grabbed instinctively for his sword

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri kills a Phyrexian construct by summoning the metal sand against it and driving her blade through it.
timeline.quote: She twisted once, and the shape beneath the mounded sand was still.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri explains that a planar shield scattered the team on arrival, and that she shook off the sand's hypnosis because it is made of metal.
timeline.quote: we slammed into some sort of planar shield when we breached New Phyrexia

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reveals a scratch on her neck and shows her blood still runs red, assuring Kaito she is fine.
timeline.quote: My blood's still red. No oil. I'll be fine.

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 1: Uncontrolled Descent" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth wakes alone on New Phyrexia and fights off six Phyrexians until Kaya joins her.
timeline.quote: a purple-tinged blade thrust through a Phyrexian heart

citation.work: Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations
citation.text: "Assault on New Phyrexia | Episode 2: Unstable Foundations" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2023.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Wrenn arrive on New Phyrexia and find a bright landscape dominated by a vast Invasion Tree.
timeline.quote: Chandra can't comprehend how tall the Invasion Tree is.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
timeline.quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
timeline.quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
timeline.quote: Urabrask serves no one.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
timeline.quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 5: Cathartic Reunion" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Geralf explains the Phyrexians seek to turn Innistrad into an outpost of their empire, and that their oil cannot infect risen dead.
timeline.quote: They wish to transform our glorious home into one more outpost along their long road to empire.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Innistrad: Family Game Night" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn and Eight tear holes across planes and see the Phyrexian invasion everywhere.
timeline.quote: Fires churning in his belly, Eight reaches for new planes.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
timeline.quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 8: Wrenn and Eight" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks to Ravnica, which is at war with the Phyrexians, and searches for Vraska's mind.
timeline.quote: Ravnica is at war, again

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Epilogue 1: Bring the End, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Apr 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Jace quarrel over their fight on New Phyrexia and the sylex.
timeline.quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!

citation.work: Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back
citation.text: "Duskmourn: House of Horror | Episode 3: Don't Look Back" by Mira Grant. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Aug 2024.

timeline.summary: Ajani confesses to Elspeth that he joined Phyrexia willingly and apologizes for trying to kill her.
timeline.quote: I was not forced. I was not compelled. I did it willingly.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Tam found the Theorist's earlier self lost in a vision of Phyrexia's attack on Vryn.
timeline.quote: She knows without doubt that this was Vryn under Phyrexian attack

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 1: Tam, Alive" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: Ajani joins the Machine Orthodoxy and presides over Karn's dismantling.
timeline.quote: Ajani joined the Machine Orthodoxy and presided over Karn's dismantling

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani intercepts the strike force at the Seedcore and Elspeth knocks him unconscious.
timeline.quote: Elspeth pummeled him with the hilt of her blade, knocking him unconscious

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani executes the praetor Sheoldred on Norn's command.
timeline.quote: Ajani executed the praetor Sheoldred

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra discover a stone in the Caves of Koilos; disturbed, it splits into Mightstone and Weakstone and unleashes Phyrexia's evil on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: unleashing the evil of Phyrexia on Dominaria

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza leads planeswalkers to Phyrexia, and Gerrard and Urza are forced to fight repeatedly in an arena, revived by Yawgmoth, until Urza is decapitated and Gerrard escapes with the head.
timeline.quote: Eventually, Urza is decapitated and Gerrard escapes with the head

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth sets Gerrard and Urza to fight in an arena filled with his avatars, promising to grant the winner's wish.
timeline.quote: Their new master creates an arena which he fills with countless avatars of himself

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza, rejects Yawgmoth's reward, sees through a Hanna-avatar, and is flung out of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Gerrard wins the duel by decapitating Urza.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The remaining Nine Titans set off the last Soul Bomb, gutting Phyrexia, but Yawgmoth has already left and arrives on Dominaria as a death cloud.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth finally comes back to Dominaria, after 9000 years, in the form of a death cloud

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On New Phyrexia Ashiok tricks Elesh Norn with a fake failed compleation; Norn attacks and Ashiok leaves behind an Elspeth figure in Norn's armor.
timeline.quote: making it appear as if her glistening oil failed to properly compleat a Mirran woman

citation.text: "Ashiok", section "On New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avila's former lover, turned into a Phyrexian agent, poisons her and delivers her body to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: He poisoned Avila despite his love for her

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Phyrexia, Abcal-dro reconstructs Avila's body as a cyborg, names her Belbe and implants the Eye of Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: A black sphere was then implanted in her body

citation.text: "Belbe", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza drains Tevesh Szat to power the soul bombs and later destroys Taysir; the Titans mutiny.
timeline.quote: Urza used the same failsafe and destroyed Taysir.

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Levar leads the last Titans to plant the bombs and destroy Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Levar led the last titans to plant the bombs and destroy the plane .

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Nine Titans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth intervenes; Chandra and Koth fight to the tree and Wrenn fuses with Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Wrenn managed to fuse with Realmbreaker.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa is un-compleated and Chandra chooses to stay with the desparked Nissa.
timeline.quote: Chandra chose to stay with the desparked Nissa

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's research on kami lets New Phyrexia compleat a planeswalker without removing the soul; Tamiyo is the first.
timeline.quote: which they put into practice by compleating Tamiyo

citation.text: "Compleation", section "Description and process". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias subjects captive planeswalkers like Ajani Goldmane to ever more painful procedures.
timeline.quote: eagerly subjected captive Planeswalkers like Ajani Goldmane to ever more effective

citation.text: "Compleation", section "Description and process". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn, Kaya, Koth, Melira and Teferi Akosa perform a ritual to un-compleat Ajani and Nissa; Melira dies and Karn loses his spark.
timeline.quote: The process was so taxing as to kill Melira and cost Karn his spark

citation.text: "Compleation", section "Healing Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri is cured of compleation by unclear means.
timeline.quote: Nahiri, another planeswalker, was also cured of compleation

citation.text: "Compleation", section "Healing Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska are un-compleated through a three-pronged process involving Jace's mental preservation, a telepathic command and Ranna's healing.
timeline.quote: Jace and Vraska were also un-compleated, through a three-pronged process.

citation.text: "Compleation", section "Healing Compleation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crovax is taken to Phyrexia, where Kirril compleats him into a Phyrexian and he is groomed as evincar of Rath.
timeline.quote: he was to become the new evincar of Rath, needing only to prove himself to his masters before he could take the throne.

citation.text: "Crovax", section "Dark rebirth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the end of the war, Urza discovers the dark plane of Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: At the end of this war, Urza discovered the dark plane of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight and its crew, with the Legacy including Karn, thwart Phyrexia's near invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia nearly invaded Dominaria, were it not for the skyship Weatherlight and its crew.

citation.text: "Dominaria". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rebbec seals the portal to Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia as Halcyon falls.
timeline.quote: Rebbec managed to seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Thran Empire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Atraxa is captured at the Phyrexian conquest of Mirrodin and compleated by Norn, marking Phyrexia's final victory over Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Atraxa's creation marked the final victory of Phyrexia over Mirrodin.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Rise of the praetors". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn overwhelms Sheoldred's and Urabrask's forces and becomes the dominant praetor, the Mother of Machines.
timeline.quote: She then became the Mother of Machines, the highest power in New Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Victorious". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn tries to compleat a Mirran woman, but the compleation fails because of a nightmare produced by Ashiok; Norn vows to kill Elspeth.
timeline.quote: Enraged, Norn vowed she would kill Elspeth

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Meeting Ashiok". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret bargains his Planar Bridge and the Reality Chip for a darksteel body, enabling the infiltrations of Kaldheim and Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Norn felt confident to send troops across the planes.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Invasion plans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sheoldred is sent to Dominaria to fetch Karn, whom Norn welcomes back as Father of Machines and introduces to Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn successfully sent Sheoldred to Dominaria in a large-scale infiltration to fetch Karn .

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Invasion plans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A planeswalker strike team arrives too late to destroy Realmbreaker; Kaya and Kaito hesitate and Norn appears with compleated Nissa to thwart the mission as the invasion begins.
timeline.quote: This mistake was all it took for Norn to appear with a compleated Nissa Revane and thwart the mission.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Multiversal conquest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn's forces capture the rebelling Sheoldred and Norn has compleated Ajani execute her.
timeline.quote: Norn commanded the compleated planeswalker Ajani to execute Sheoldred, ending her rival's threat.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Multiversal conquest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn dispatches her compleated planeswalkers and Atraxa to conquer home planes, Theros and New Capenna.
timeline.quote: Finally, she gave the most important task to Atraxa .

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Multiversal conquest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn, Koth and Urabrask invade the inner spheres but are defeated at the Fair Basilica; Elspeth bursts from the Blind Eternities to save them.
timeline.quote: the newly anointed archangel Elspeth burst from the Blind Eternities, giving the planeswalkers time to escape

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth duels Norn to a stalemate, stabbing her through the shoulder, and flies off to cover the attack on Realmbreaker.
timeline.quote: was subsequently stabbed through the shoulder by Elspeth.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirran rebels raise a barrier while Wrenn fuses with Realmbreaker to reach Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Successfully merging herself with the cosmic tree, Wrenn reached out across the Multiverse

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn flings Elspeth through the barrier, shattering it, as Wrenn opens a portal summoning Teferi and the Zhalfiran army.
timeline.quote: Norn finally seized the angel planeswalker and flung her body through the barrier, shattering it.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Final Battle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Zhalfiran army turns the tide, Vorinclex is killed, and Wrenn shifts Zhalfir into New Phyrexia's place in the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: The Green Praetor Vorinclex was soon killed in the melee

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi's forces strike Norn with a volley of magic.
timeline.quote: all striking Norn in the chest and further wounding her, though she continued to stand her ground.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias mutinies and turns his army upon Norn.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias chose this time to mutiny

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn wipes out her assailants but is gravely wounded and crawls toward the portal to Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: Norn crawled toward the planar portal connecting New Phyrexia and Zhalfir

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn breaks his vow of pacifism and shreds Norn's mechanical components, killing her.
timeline.quote: broke his vow of pacifism and used his machine magic to shred her mechanical components

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Norn's death silences the Phyrexian hive mind, shutting down invaders across all planes and ending the multiversal invasion.
timeline.quote: This marked the end of the multiversal invasion.

citation.text: "Elesh Norn", section "Defeat and Death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
